Package top.sywyar.pixivdownload.i18n

Interface NamespaceMessageResolver

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface NamespaceMessageResolver
按贡献方命名空间解析本地化文案的宿主端口。

调用方只提交稳定的 namespace、key 与目标语言；活动贡献快照的选择、资源物化和 fallback 策略由宿主实现负责。namespace 或 key 不可用时返回空结果。
